1.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_COMP
1.description: Of late, all I can think about is Weapons, Weapons, Weapons. I channel this passion into crafting homages of my favorite warmachina, which is more than a mere hobby! It is the wind in my sails!

2.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_Q1_000_001
2.description: Which of my creations would you like to see?

4.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_NOSELECT_000
4.description: Ah. Well, that is not quite the level of enthusiasm I was hoping for. But I am not one to be so easily deterred! Should you have a change of heart, I am ever ready to display my masterworks!

5.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_000
5.description: Alas, I am lacking fresh inspiration, and I fear that without the necessary stimulation, my tools will be left to gather dust...

6.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_001
6.description: The Ruby Weapon? A fine choice! Please, allow me a moment to prepare.

7.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_002
7.description: Feast your eyes on the likeness of the Crimson Conqueror, the Vermilion Villain, the Scarlet...Scoundrel, the one and only Ruby Weapon!

8.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_003
8.description: As I am sure you remember, its most prominent characteristics were its impregnable armor plating, adroitly depicted here, and its long, flexible claws, which are...well, you'll just have to imagine those for now.

9.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_004
9.description: The head and arched neck are somewhat reminiscent of a ravenous voidsent, which may be the result of having absorbed a primal, possibly even one summoned by those resisting the Empire. In that sense, it could even be considered an ally of sorts!

10.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_005
10.description: Ah, there I go, getting carried away as usual!

11.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_006
11.description: I can tell you've absorbed about as much information as you can handle for now, so why don't we fire up the Real Virtuality Combat Simulation Experiencinator?

12.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_100_006
12.description: You'd best brace yourself, because even I don't know what's going to happen!

13.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_010
13.description: Why, yes! Of course! Just a moment, please...

14.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_100_010
14.description: Oof! Gods be good, this thing weighs a tonze! Perhaps I should've used lighter materials...

15.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_200_010
15.description: So, what do you think? Is it every bit as terrifying as the foe you faced? Behold the Malevolent Malachite Marauder, the Vicious Viridian Villain, the Jumentous Jade Giant! (...Actually, perhaps not that last one.) Anyway, it's the Emerrraaald Weeeaaapon!

16.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_011
16.description: I assure you, I spared no expense in making it as true to life, so to speak, as possible!

17.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_012
17.description: The information we received regarding its design revealed several startling details. Perhaps most surprising of all were the free-floating manipulators─or hands, if you prefer─which allowed it to attack from multiple angles simultaneously!

18.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_013
18.description: We even learned that their positioning was based on tactics used by Gaius himself when he led the imperial invasion of Werlyt. By surrounding the target, they are able to bombard it from all sides while keeping it pinned down.

19.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_014
19.description: Not only that, but the Emerald Weapon was able to perfectly replicate Gaius's renowned Terminus Est gunblade technique, though on a much larger scale. I wish I could've been there to see it for myself! Oooh... You're so lucky!

20.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_015
20.description: Haha, goodness me, all this talking has made me rather parched.

21.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_016
21.description: But before I pour myself a nice glass of local arak, I think it's time for us to fire up the Real Virtuality Combat Simulation Experiencinator, to see what wonders it can conjure.

22.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_017
22.description: <hex:021A020203>Anything<hex:021A020103> could happen, so don't say I didn't warn you!

23.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_020
23.description: An excellent choice. I'll have it ready in a jiffy!

24.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_021
24.description: Here it is! The most formidable of all Weapons, one that requires no introduction. Having said that, I'll give one regardless!

25.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_022
25.description: Let me begin with its alternate name, AEW-I-Z. Like the other models, it is an “Anti-Eikon Warmachina” and the “I” is a numeral indicating that it belongs to the first series of prototypes. “Z” seems to imply that it's the final version.

26.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_023
26.description: This is merely conjecture on my part, but the Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald Weapons appear to have been designed from the outset to gather data for making improvements to the Diamond Weapon.

27.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_024
27.description: But that's not all. The Diamond Weapon was equipped with a certain...element that the other models lacked. This enabled it to reach its final, perfected state. But it's the nature of this element that troubles me...

28.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_025
28.description: Even after reading the reports, I'm still having trouble coming to terms with the sacrifices made in the name of the Weapon project. Perhaps we should give a moment of silence for the young lives lost...

29.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_026
29.description: ...I was planning to give this sculpture to the people of Werlyt, as a reminder of the brave souls whose deeds eventually led to independence from the Empire.

30.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_000_027
30.description: As with my previous works, the sculpture can also be used to reenact your encounter with the Weapon. I hope it will prove useful in preparing for whatever the future holds in store.

31.name: TEXT_REGGYR4WEAPONSGIENGINEER_00656_SYSTEM_000_900
31.description: The totems earned in the Sorrow of Werlyt can be exchanged for gear and other items by speaking with C'intana in Revenant's Toll.
